scope: reclamation runtime-lifetime gate review; no erase implementation
facts: Host mode documents generic button event behavior
retained external protocol documents shared global macro addresses
not_proved: whether mode switch terminates an already running macro
whether profile reload creates a macro execution quiescence barrier
whether a macro VM can continue reading old storage after its binding changes
engineering_inference: absence of current binding references alone cannot certify that an old in-flight macro has finished; design gate, not observed physical bug
policy: do not erase old nonempty pages without proven runtime quiescence and full reference/ownership checks
conclusion_limit: does not claim firmware lacks a stop facility; retained interfaces do not prove one
